offering_description.value: Provides cloud-based payroll and human capital management software to employers, with implementation and payroll administration services.

primary_products.value: Payroll software; human resources management software; time and attendance software; benefits administration software; recruiting and talent management software; employee engagement software

primary_services.value: Software implementation; payroll processing; payroll tax filing and remittance

items.detail: Employers, including small and midsized businesses and private nonprofit organizations

end_markets.value: Professional services; healthcare; manufacturing; retail; hospitality; nonprofit organizations; other employer industries

items.detail: Recurring fees for access to payroll and human resources software, generally based on employees served and selected modules
Fees for implementation and payroll-related services
Interest earned on client funds held before payroll and tax disbursement
Develops and operates cloud software that employers use to manage payroll and their workforce
Processes employer payroll data and handles associated tax filings and payments

geography_served.detail: Serves employers throughout the United States

company_size.value: Established national software provider with a broad workforce management suite serving small and midsized employers across industries

specialization.detail: Payroll, human resources, workforce management, benefits administration and talent management software

items.detail: Sales teams sell software subscriptions directly to employers
Referral relationships with benefits brokers, financial advisers and other employer service providers
Cloud platform delivers software to customers through web and mobile applications

regulatory_exposure.detail: Payroll processing and tax remittance are subject to IRS and state tax requirements; handling employee information creates data privacy and security obligations
